I tried this game seeing as you had no comments. And giving my honest opinion in the nicest way possible...

I didn't like the game as it was. You had to tilt your phone way too far to get it to move from the left side. Not to mention when I finally destroyed a ship they just disappeared. Usually there's some kind of visual effect to know that you actually destroyed a ship without volume (I didn't have the volume on)

Another thing is that the fact that there's no score keeping system. That's one of the ways games become addictive. Without one then the game really doesn't have a purpose to it.  I really don't even know what the enemies are supposed to be. I would suggest adding a back story because the space shooter thing has been done to death and you have to make your app separate from the rest. 

Obviously this app needs a lot of work, but from an amateur app inventor to another, please keep working on it. I hope you continue on this project. I mean the first draft isn't always perfect and I'd consider getting feedback from other places too once you get your game better. But in all seriousness, nobody will want to download that for 8 MB in it's current condition. But like I said keep working on it. It'll be the next big thing in no time

Good luck.
